status: Integrated: inventory, sales and transfers page-size adapters share one lazy shell/action and action-only CSS. Source/hash, synthetic DOM and emitted graph evidence only; browser/pixel acceptance remains open.
lineHashConvention: UTF-8 original lines, inclusive bounds, each range ends with LF.

sourceRanges.use: Host/select/tag/page-size declarations, copied with selector scoping only; source11 ShadowRoot portal structure excluded.
Input/icon/menu/option declarations, copied with selector scoping only.
Real Arco Select leaf, tag display fallback, local popup container, trigger settings; adapted to explicit controlled props and non-search/non-clear subset.
Page-size presentation detection and tl/150 popup policy; only presentation policy retained, no native DOM reading.
Entity-session replacement/close/stale-work intent informs new ownership lifecycle; no original global entity/data bridge copied.
Outside/Escape/cleanup intent only; global listeners and singleton explicitly not copied.

adaptations: A single .demo-single-select wrapper replaces ShadowRoot boundaries; copied declarations retain source values, selectors gain this scope.
Only Select/style/index.css and Trigger/style/index.css are imported as action-only CSS; no all-library barrel, full CSS, palette/body reset or global bridge.
Direct leaf type assertion handles installed NodeNext package typing without importing a barrel at runtime or type time.
Caller owns applied value/options and lazy loading; source optimistic local value, scan/mount maps, nativeData/transferData/entityData and global ERP data are excluded.
Narrow required-value ungrouped non-search/non-clear subset matches the three page-size widgets. Group/recommendation/empty-sentinel/search/creator/fit adapters are not included.
Controlled popup, unmountOnExit, local-only portal, disable dismissal, guarded StrictMode portal refresh and explicit focus-on-mount are lifecycle adapters, not copied frozen behavior.

ExclusivePopupController is entirely new pure lifecycle code. It is session-owned, closes/revokes earlier ownership, removes scope-abort listeners and rejects stale handles. It installs no document listeners.

Closing popup option callbacks are ignored when open is false, so the normal Arco exit animation cannot commit after ownership replacement. Host callbacks must still revalidate live scope/lease before publishing.

installedArco.iconRules: Four static .arco-icon/attribute rules copied from es/style/index.css and scoped; see existing demo-presentation/ARCO-LICENSE.

notChanged: No schema, data/query contract, filters, business math, package/dependency, external service or deployment changes. The three pager presentations/loading owners are integrated; unrelated controls are not migrated.
